claims.claim: Selected official Commander product dispatches to comm_gauss_br_mod_v3 using sigma.fits and TT2–29. The Fortran caller converts input calibrated microkelvin-squared Cl to Dl by ell(ell+1)/(2pi).

For each ell, initialization skips low rows with abs(x+5)<1e-4, takes Cl at first nonsaturated index+2 as lower; skips high rows with abs(x-5)<1e-4, takes index−2 as upper. Compute returns −1d30 if Dl<lower or Dl>upper. Equality with bounds passes this check. These are calibrated likelihood table margins, not a cosmological physical prior.

Within range, cubic interpolation maps Dl to x; Gaussian quadratic is augmented by log(dx/dDl). Any derivative<=0 sets lnL=−1d30 and exits; final return subtracts the stored offset. Therefore a sentinel-scale result alone does not distinguish range failure from derivative failure.

A matching diagnostic must use exact sigma.fits header LMIN/LMAX/NBIN and Fortran first-HDU layout(nbin,lmin:lmax,3), selected ell2–29, the source cubic/locate conventions and calibrated Dl=theory Cl*ell(ell+1)/(2pi*A_planck²). It should return violating ell, table limits/coordinate, derivative and exact branch separately, not convert either sentinel into physical minus infinity. Exact build numeric conventions also matter: clik_gibbs.f90 declares an unsuffixed PI literal; match compiled flags rather than assume binary64 mathematical pi.
